meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织好画面轨道与子合成,让项目如期渲染
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做动画合成,想一次写对项目结构避免返工
copy.tagline_en: Organize tracks and sub-compositions to make your project render reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're creating animated compositions and want to get the structure right without rework

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的规则,把视频内容写成一份网页式的合成文件:每段素材的开始时间用简单标记写清,媒体播放由框架管理;之后可检查、预览并渲染成片。
howto.when: 当你想新建或修改 HyperFrames 合成的时间、媒体或子合成结构,或写 STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md 这类计划时。

say.text: 搭一个 5 秒的 HyperFrames 最小合成骨架。
say.note: 会给你最小工程并检查根节点尺寸。

say.text: 在这个合成里加一段视频,让它从第 2 秒开始。
say.note: 会设置视频的开始与结束标记,并做规则检查。

say.text: 先写 STORYBOARD.md,列好镜头和转场。
say.note: 生成分镜计划文档,供你确认后再搭合成。

howto.what_en: Claude writes video content as a renderable HTML composition under HyperFrames rules: clip timing is declared with data-* attributes, media playback is framework-owned, and the project can then be checked, previewed, and rendered.
howto.when_en: When you want to create or edit a HyperFrames composition (timing, media, or sub-composition structure), or write a STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan.

say_en.text: Create a minimal 5-second HyperFrames composition skeleton.
say_en.note: Returns the minimal project and checks root sizing.

say_en.text: Add a video clip to this composition that starts at second 2.
say_en.note: Sets start/end markers and runs rule checks.

say_en.text: Write a STORYBOARD.md with the shots and transitions first.
say_en.note: Generates a plan document for your review before building.
